threads.body: The llama-index test env is the only instrumentation test command that doesn’t force VCR to never record. For consistency with the other instrumentation packages (and to avoid accidentally creating/depending on live network interactions when tests are added later), pass `--vcr-record=none` and ignore a potential `test_conformance.py` like the other packages do.

This repo’s instrumentation guidelines require new instrumentation packages to ship minimal runnable examples under `examples/manual/` and `examples/zero-code/` (and, when documenting completion hooks, a `custom_hook.py` example mirroring the OpenAI package). This package README documents usage/completion hooks but no examples are included yet.

+OpenTelemetry LlamaIndex Instrumentation
+========================================
+
+|pypi|
+
+.. |pypi| image:: https://badge.fury.io/py/opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-llama-index.svg
+   :target: https://pypi.org/project/opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-llama-index/
+
+This package contains the OpenTelemetry instrumentor scaffold for
+`LlamaIndex <https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index>`_.
+
+Installation
+------------
+
+::
+
+    pip install opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-llama-index
+
+Usage
+-----
+
+.. code-block:: python
+
+    from opentelemetry.instrumentation.genai.llama_index import (
+        LlamaIndexInstrumentor,
+    )
+
+    LlamaIndexInstrumentor().instrument()
+
+Configuration
+-------------
+
+Content capture is controlled through the
+``OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT`` environment variable.
+Supported values are ``NO_CONTENT``, ``SPAN_ONLY``, ``EVENT_ONLY``, and
+``SPAN_AND_EVENT``.
+
+Prompts and completions can also be redirected via a completion hook by
+setting ``OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_COMPLETION_HOOK`` or by passing
+``instrument(completion_hook=...)``.

threads.body: The module docstring currently says it will “Instrument LlamaIndex applications”, but this scaffold only constructs a TelemetryHandler and does not wrap/patch any LlamaIndex APIs yet, so enabling the instrumentor won’t actually produce telemetry. Please reword this to avoid implying functionality that isn’t implemented.
